2 मद् (˚—) = म;
 also = abl. of the same.
मदकल a. sounding or singing softly (in love or rut).
मदखेल a. playful, wanton.

1 मदच्यु॑त् a. exciting intoxication or excited by
intoxication, gladdening, exhilarating, cheerful, merry.
2 मदच्युत् a. dropping rut-juice.
म॑दच्युत a. staggering with intoxication.
मदन m. love or the god of love.
मा॑दन a. inebriating.

मदनमह m. (great) festival held in honour of the
god of love.

मदनोत्सव m. (great) festival held in honour of the
god of love.
मदनलेख m. love-letter.
मदनलेखा f. love-letter.
मदनसंदेश m. message of love.*
*मदनसारिका f. a kind of bird.*
मदनातुर a. love-sick.

मदनावस्थ a. enamoured;
 f. आ amorousness.
मदनिका f. a woman's name.
मदनोद्यान n. N. of a garden.
म॑दन्ती f. pl. boiling water.
मदपटु a. in rut, furious (elephant).
†मदपति m. lord of the inebriating drink (Soma).
मदप्रसेक m. the aphrodisiacal fluid.
मदयन्तिका f. names of women.
मद˚यन्ती f. names of women.
मदयितृ m. intoxicater, delighter.
मदर्थम् adv. for my sake.
मदर्पण n. an offering to me.

मदलेखा f. a line of rut-juice (on an elephant's
temples.

मदान्ध a. blind through drunkenness, love, or
arrogance.
मदामद a. constantly excited.
मदाम्बु n. the rut-juice of an elephant.
मदाम्भस् n. the rut-juice of an elephant.
मदालस a. lazy from intoxication.
मदा॑वन्त् a. intoxicated, drunk.
मदावस्था f. rut (of an elephant).
मदाश्रय a. resorted to me.
मदि f. a kind of harrow or roller.
मदि˚का f. a kind of harrow or roller.
मदि॑न् a. gladdening, charming, intoxicating.

मदिर॑ a. = मदि॑न्;
 f. मदिरा any inebriating drink.

मदिरदृश् a. having beautiful (lit. intoxicating)
eyes.

मदिर˚नयन a. having beautiful (lit. intoxicating)
eyes.
मदिराक्ष (f. ई) & मदिरेक्षण a. the same.
म॑दिष्ठ superl. to मदि॑न्.
मदीय a. my, mine.
मदु॑घ m. a kind of honey-plant or liquorice.
मदोत्कट a. excited by drink, rage, or rut.
मदोदग्र a. much excited or furious.
मदोद्धत a. puffed up with pride, haughty.
मदोन्मत्त a. intoxicated by rut or arrogance.
मद्गत a. being in me.

मद्गु॑ m. a kind of aquatic bird or animal, N. of a mixed
caste.
मद्भक्त a. devoted to me.
मद्भाव m. my essence.

म॑द्य a. exhilarating, intoxicating, charming, pleasant. n.
intoxicating drink, spirituous liquor.
मद्यप m. drinking spirituous liquors, m. a drunkard.
मद्यभाण्ड n. vessel for spirituous liquor.

मद्यान्नविक्रय m. the sale of spirituous liquors
and victuals.
मद्याजिन् a. worshipping me.
मद्रि॑क् adv. towards me.
मद्वत् adv. like I or me.
मद्वन्त् a. gladdening or intoxicating.
मद्विध a. one like me.
मादक a. inebriating.
मादनीय a. inebriating.
मादयित्नु॑ a. the same.
मादयिष्णु॑ a. the same.
मादृश् (f. ई) one like me.
मादृश (f. ई) one like me.
माद्रवती f. = माद्री.
माद्रवतीपुत्र m. son of M. (Nakula or Sahadeva).

माद्रवती˚सूनु m. son of M. (Nakula or
Sahadeva).

1 माद्री f. princess of the Madras, E. of the second wife of
Pāṇḍu.

2 माद्री f. a princess of the Madras, E. of the wives of
Pāṇḍu, Kṛṣṇa, etc.
